verdicts.quote: Lightning Web Component exposed through an actual custom tab, with App Launcher visibility for authorized users … the prompt and current chat context go to xAI … Never attach Salesforce records, user identifiers, browser session credentials or unrelated context.
No Salesforce record data access is needed, so record sharing, object access and field-level access are inapplicable to the invocation as scoped.
verdicts.missing: The bot excludes records entirely. It gives no rule for answering from records under the asking user's sharing permissions.

verdicts.quote: No Salesforce record data access is needed, so record sharing, object access and field-level access are inapplicable to the invocation as scoped.
verdicts.missing: There is no field-permission check or rule for reading or displaying encrypted or restricted field values if records are used.

verdicts.quote: Use a dedicated, maintainable permission-set assignment for the intended cohort and require effective server class and outbound principal access. … The org admin controls the development org's bot entry, application access and access assignments.

The current signed-in user reads them. … No shared store, persisted transcript or cross-device recovery. … Only safe category, timing and an opaque per-attempt correlation value may be exposed through authorized diagnostics.
Use an imperative, non-cacheable invocation from the component to Apex. The Apex entry checks admission and validates the text request, then makes one HTTPS callout to the authorized xAI endpoint.
verdicts.missing: The design specifies a direct callout. It gives no asynchronous job design or transaction boundary for a trigger or preceding DML.

verdicts.quote: Salesforce Named Credential for the destination and a linked External Credential … Salesforce resolves the bearer header from the admin-provisioned encrypted parameter. … Consumers, client code, product source, error reports and application logs never receive the key.

verdicts.where: C-07/C-08, Operating conditions, capacity and cost
verdicts.quote: Salesforce documents a maximum cumulative callout timeout of 120 seconds and a Developer Edition cap of 20 concurrent external callouts.
verdicts.missing: The numerical limits for callouts per transaction, Apex heap and CPU time are unspecified. The concurrency cap measures a different limit.

verdicts.quote: Capture the outbound messages under a controlled service.
verdicts.missing: The controlled service provides a test boundary, but the specification does not require a mock implementation for Apex tests or state their restriction on real callouts.

verdicts.quote: If configuration is missing, an assigned user who can open the tab receives a safe setup-unavailable outcome on Send. … Use a modern Salesforce Named Credential for the destination
request a foreground non-streaming response … Return only safe outcome fields to the component.
verdicts.missing: The interface receives the foreground invocation result. No notification or status mechanism delivers an answer after a background job completes.

verdicts.quote: Current pending attempt receives usable completed text before deadline → commit one pair and clear pending/draft. Foreign, stale or already terminal attempts have no UI effect.
verdicts.missing: The guard prevents duplicate completion of one page attempt. There is no message-level idempotency rule across job retries or re-enqueues.

verdicts.quote: Configuration/provider auth or entitlement failures direct the user to the org admin. Rate limit or transient service failure offers a later manual Send. An offline, disconnected or timed-out attempt reports that a reply could not be obtained.
The app issues no automatic retry. … Configuration/provider auth or entitlement failures direct the user to the org admin. Rate limit or transient service failure offers a later manual Send.

An offline, disconnected or timed-out attempt reports that a reply could not be obtained. … Incomplete, nonterminal, malformed, blank, refusal-only or otherwise unusable replies show that Grok did not return a usable answer.
It holds only completed pairs in their original order, plus at most one editable draft or pending attempt.
verdicts.missing: The page represents speaker text and pending or completed turns. There is no stored conversation and turn schema with timestamps, model identifier and usage counts.

verdicts.quote: Refresh, teardown or detected session loss discards app-held state. … Provider-controlled audit or contractual retention is independent of UI clearing.
verdicts.missing: The specification gives no user-account deletion rule for an open chat or for copies retained by the provider.

verdicts.quote: the prompt and current chat context go to xAI and that only synthetic, non-sensitive data belongs in this development bot. … Never attach Salesforce records, user identifiers, browser session credentials or unrelated context.
Context overflow sends nothing and offers **New chat**. … Never silently omit history. … The unit and values are open.
verdicts.missing: The builder still needs the context limit and its unit to determine exactly when to block Send.

verdicts.quote: First Send has empty history. … Empty and whitespace-only drafts trigger no outbound request. … Accept an otherwise valid message and accumulated context at their respective configured inclusive input bounds.

verdicts.where: C-02, C-08, AD-2, Service contracts (Owned event coverage)
verdicts.quote: Recheck the next Send after the admin removes the grants. … Configure a fixed permitted model server-side. … Bot-owned call result categories cover success, configuration/auth, rate limit, provider error, timeout and unusable response.
verdicts.missing: The specification assigns access removal to the admin and defines failure categories, but leaves the administrator's model-change procedure and access to individual failure diagnostics unspecified.

verdicts.quote: Neither prompt/answer content nor the API key is written to application storage, logs or error output. … S6 describes default audit deletion after 30 days.
verdicts.missing: The provider audit has a stated default lifetime, but no audit record links the asking user to the prompt and reply. The app explicitly excludes that content from its logs.

verdicts.quote: Use nonsecret config for environment differences. … operator deploys eligible metadata → org admin enables scoped access only after terminal success and read-back.
verdicts.missing: The target org type, credential differences across environments and production deployment coverage requirement are unspecified.

verdicts.quote: An eligible Send shows the pending user turn and **Waiting for Grok** … The implementer and product owner must settle the response and client deadlines with the target limits and an approved model.
verdicts.missing: The user-visible pending state is defined, but there is no adopted end-to-end answer deadline or latency target.

verdicts.where: C-01, C-07, C-08, Interaction and accessibility checks
verdicts.quote: The empty state explains how to start … **Waiting for Grok** … Error persists beside the composer with the recovery action. … refusal-only or otherwise unusable replies show that Grok did not return a usable answer.
Preserve existing identities, access assignments, unrelated metadata, automation and records.
